title: Adventurous Yeasty Croatian Asparagus Skillet
description: A low-carb friendly Croatian dish featuring asparagus and a mother-sauce base, cooked to perfection in a tava griddle with a yeasty and glassy-jelly texture. This adventurous recipe is sure to delight your taste buds.
instructions: Heat the butter in a tava griddle over medium heat until melted.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add the asparagus and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the yeast, chicken broth, and heavy cream.
Pour the yeast mixture over the asparagus and onion mixture in the tava griddle.
Season with salt, black pepper, and paprika, and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes, until the sauce has thickened and the yeast is activated.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
